target.identity_scope: BTC venue-scoped crypto binding; no cross-venue executable price equivalence

request.range: No query parameters; native range must be inspected, never presumed
request.redirect_policy: manual; any 3xx consumes the single attempt and stops
request.cache_key_rule: ROOT generates one probe id/cache key and reuses its terminal result; no second provider dispatch
request.response_bound_contract: ROOT broker constructor max_response_bytes=262144; per-request response-size argument is not implemented

primary_documentation.route_evidence: Developers Other endpoints table explicitly lists /api/liquidation-levels/<coin> as model estimate with model_version, levels and max pain.
primary_documentation.free_access_scope: Public docs say free, key optional. Actual runtime access, response shape and measured expense unverified.
primary_documentation.terms: Attribution link to Swolecharts/source page, honor Cache-Control, no SLA and no resale/raw feed repackaging.
primary_documentation.rate_scope: Developers Optional key list calls other endpoints unmetered; listed key/IP exports have30 network/120 key per minute. This is not an unbounded project allowance.

primary_model.inputs: Price/OI/volume history plus a liquidation-distance distribution calibrated on Hyperliquid positions; same distribution reused across assets/venues.
primary_model.magnitudes: RELATIVE_INTENSITY_ONLY; a field named usd remains modeled intensity, not actual USD positions.

before_map_use: Actual Swole canonical BTC/Bitcoin identity binding to this underlying, beyond a bare ticker; payload or primary provider metadata with exact model coin. This packet has documented BTC examples but no native map identity readback.

Actual payload estimated flag, model_version, native venue composition/market id and source event time. Payload must match a qualified model version; generated/received/HTTP Date is not the modeled as_of.
Explicit as_of clock semantics+units, no future clock, model age<=300000ms from original source time; downloads/cache reads do not refresh event age.
Actual lo/hi/mid bounds and liquidated long/short side, range and available sides; invalid bins rejected, one-sided result remains partial.
Exact modeled amount field and scale tied to the payload model_version. Use relative intensity, never dollars or missing zero.

Qualified source price currency and comparable source market. Current time-aligned price basis/conversion to BingX USDT, with original timestamps, expiry and proof. Source price and reference<=30000ms old, not merely a5min-fresh model map.
Retain native bounds/currency/venue; absent basis => NOT_FOR_EXACT_BINGX_ORDERS and no fake multiplier1. USD is not automatically USDT.
Primary provider/model overlap group and unknown composition preserved; do not sum bins/nested aggregates/nativeHL positions as independent notional.

frozen_adapter_expected_interface.scope: Existing A parser expectations ONLY, NOT a verified live schema.
frozen_adapter_expected_interface.if_interface_differs: Preserve raw private receipt and exact incompatible path; ROOT agrees any minimal adapter patch before source code changes.

cost.cache_policy: ROOT honors response Cache-Control while preserving source age; no new own ledger.
cost.backoff: ROOT durable429/Retry-After/provider backoff; no immediate retry; spent/unknown preserved.

expected_interface.scope: Existing A parser expectations ONLY, NOT a verified live schema.
expected_interface.if_interface_differs: Preserve raw private receipt and exact incompatible path; ROOT agrees any minimal adapter patch before source code changes.

as_of.semantics: source model as_of; not received/generated/HTTP Date

coverage.overlap: retain primary provider and model/version; never sum as independent positions

required_native_qualification: Canonical Swole BTC/Bitcoin binding beyond ticker, tied to independently curated BingX100 BTC underlying
Actual estimated flag and payload model_version; document methodology version is not payload version
Source as_of semantics and milliseconds, current model age and original receipt
Native venue/market composition, price quote, source bounds and sides
Actual magnitude field and version-bound scale; retain relative intensity even if field name usd
Current qualified source-to-BingX price mapping with original clock <=30000ms and proof for exact orders
activation.price_mapping_rule: Reuse only an already admitted, current qualified mapping; missing/old basis means NOT_FOR_EXACT_BINGX_ORDERS. Do not perform a second HTTP within the one-probe cap.
activation.route_config: Fill inactive nulls only from real reviewed evidence; then ROOT may add to existing registry. active=false alone is not the existing validator guard.

rejection_criteria: No positive fresh whole/provider/native/SQL admission: do not dispatch
Any access/HTTP/redirect/timeout/byte-bound/JSON error: stop; preserve spent or unknown
coin mismatch or canonical identity unqualified: retain receipt, no verified route
Payload differs from existing parser: record exact incompatible path; no invented missing fields
estimated!==true or missing model_version: model unqualified
as_of missing/future/wrong unit/older than300000ms: not current map
Invalid/nonpositive/unordered bounds, >1000 bins per side, wrong side vs source price: reject invalid interface
Unknown amount/scale: intensity null, never USD or zero
Unknown quote or unavailable current price basis: no exact BingX orders
has_data=false: observed absence only, not permanent coverage assertion
